_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Core profile UML. Source: metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/cdifProperties/cdifCore/cdifCoreSchema.json. The Core profile vocabulary is schema.org + dcterms + prov + dcat, almost entirely outside DDI-CDI's UML. Pattern used: mappingType=new with v1.1 sourceClass when there is a plausible DDI-CDI provenance anchor (Dataset<-DataStore, Person<-Individual, Organization<-Organization, ProvActivity<-Activity, MonetaryGrant<-FundingInformation, CatalogRecord<-CatalogDetails). Classes with no DDI-CDI counterpart (DataDownload, WebAPI, Contributor, DefinedTerm, LabeledLink, DerivedFrom) are plain new. Required Core attributes per the JSON schema: @id, @type, @context (modelled in metadata block), schema:name, schema:identifier, schema:dateModified, schema:subjectOf, AND (license OR conditionsOfAccess), AND (url OR distribution). This file covers the required attributes plus the commonly-used optional ones; rarely-used attributes (sameAs, publishingPrinciples, contributor) are included where space allows but with shorter definitions.

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Core Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Core schema.org-based metadata properties for any CDIF-described resource
targetModel.definition: CDIF Core profile - the foundational schema.org-based metadata properties applicable to any resource type (default schema:Dataset). Composed by every higher CDIF profile (Discovery, DataDescription, DataStructure, Codelist, complete). Anchors: schema:Dataset (data resource), schema:DataDownload / schema:WebAPI (distributions), schema:Person / schema:Organization (agents), schema:subjectOf -> CdifCatalogRecord (metadata-about-the-metadata), prov:wasGeneratedBy -> prov:Activity, prov:wasDerivedFrom (sources).
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Core schema.org-aligned metadata for FAIR resource description.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Resource and agent classes for the CDIF Core profile.

package.name: Provenance
package.definition: Provenance classes for prov:wasGeneratedBy and prov:wasDerivedFrom.

package.name: Support
package.definition: Supporting structured types: DefinedTerm, Identifier (PropertyValue), LabeledLink, CatalogRecord.

class._comment: schema:Dataset - the resource being described. DDI-CDI provenance anchor: DataStore (the data-housing concept). Note that DDI-CDI's PhysicalDataSet is closer to a schema:DataDownload than to a schema:Dataset (which is the abstract resource).
class.definition: schema:Dataset - the resource being described. Acts as the root of a CDIF metadata document.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - primary resolvable URI for the resource. Required.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - descriptive name. Required.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short summary describing the resource.

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.definition: schema:additionalType - identifiers for datatypes from other vocabularies (URI or DefinedTerm).

attribute.name: sameAs
attribute.definition: schema:sameAs - other identifiers for the resource as IRI references or structured PropertyValues.

attribute.name: version
attribute.definition: schema:version - version number or identifier.

attribute.name: inLanguage
attribute.definition: schema:inLanguage - language of the dataset content.

attribute.name: dateModified
attribute.definition: schema:dateModified - ISO 8601 last-updated date. Required.

attribute.name: datePublished
attribute.definition: schema:datePublished - ISO 8601 publication date.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - landing page URL. Either url OR distribution is required.

attribute.name: license
attribute.definition: schema:license - license URI or label. Either license OR conditionsOfAccess is required.

attribute.name: conditionsOfAccess
attribute.definition: schema:conditionsOfAccess - access-condition text or URI. Either conditionsOfAccess OR license is required.

attribute.name: publishingPrinciples
attribute.definition: schema:publishingPrinciples - maintenance/update/expected-time-to-live policies.

attribute.name: keywords
attribute.definition: schema:keywords - keywords as strings or DefinedTerms.

attribute.name: relatedLink
attribute.definition: schema:relatedLink - a related resource link.

sssom.predicate_label: Dataset is the schema.org-aligned root resource; DDI-CDI DataStore is its closest conceptual anchor (the housing of organized data).
sssom.comment: schema:Dataset is broader than DDI-CDI DataStore; DataStore in DDI-CDI excludes the metadata-about-the-dataset semantics that schema:Dataset implies. Mapping is conceptual only.

class._comment: AbstractDistribution - abstract supertype of DataDownload and WebAPI (union-type-policy: v1.1 generalization). Lets the Dataset_distribution association target a single end instead of one per concrete kind. Carries the attributes common to both (identifier, name, description). Concrete subclasses keep the kind-specific attributes and the appropriate multiplicity for url.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for resource distributions (DataDownload for files, WebAPI for service endpoints). Use the concrete subclass that matches the access method.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI for this distribution.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-readable name for this distribution.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short summary of this distribution.

sssom.object_label: CDIF Core AbstractDistribution (polymorphic over schema:DataDownload + schema:WebAPI)
sssom.comment: Introduced as an abstract parent so the Dataset_distribution association can target one end. JSON instances always use the concrete schema:DataDownload or schema:WebAPI in @type.

class._comment: schema:DataDownload - file-based distribution. DDI-CDI PhysicalDataSet is the closest provenance anchor (it represents the byte-level realization of a dataset). Inherits identifier, name, description from AbstractDistribution.
class.definition: schema:DataDownload - a downloadable file distribution of a Dataset. Inherits identifier/name/description from AbstractDistribution.

attribute.name: contentUrl
attribute.definition: schema:contentUrl - direct URL to fetch the bytes.

attribute.name: encodingFormat
attribute.definition: schema:encodingFormat - MIME type or other media-type identifier.

attribute.name: contentSize
attribute.definition: schema:contentSize - file size of this distribution (e.g. '2.5 MB' or a byte count).

attribute.name: checksum
attribute.definition: spdx:checksum / schema:checksum - integrity hash for the bytes.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - @id of a standard or specification this distribution conforms to.

sssom.predicate_label: DataDownload is the schema.org expression of a downloadable physical realization of a dataset.

class._comment: schema:WebAPI - API distribution. No DDI-CDI counterpart; pure schema.org concept. Inherits identifier, name, description from AbstractDistribution.
class.definition: schema:WebAPI - an API distribution endpoint. Used as an alternative to schema:DataDownload for service-mediated access. Inherits identifier/name/description from AbstractDistribution.

attribute.name: documentation
attribute.definition: schema:documentation - URL of API documentation.

attribute.name: termsOfService
attribute.definition: schema:termsOfService - terms of service for using the API (URI or labeled reference).

attribute.name: serviceType
attribute.definition: schema:serviceType - the type of the web API service.

attribute.name: potentialAction
attribute.definition: schema:potentialAction - @id reference to a schema:Action that can be invoked via the API.

class._comment: Agent - abstract supertype of Person and Organization (v1.1 generalization). Carries the attributes common to both (identifier, name) so associations like Dataset_creator_Agent can target a single end. Has no direct DDI-CDI source class; conceptually corresponds to prov:Agent and the schema.org agent role pattern.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for actors that can play roles on a dataset (creator, publisher, contributor, funder). Use Person or Organization as the concrete realisation.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - resolvable URI (e.g. ORCID for Person, ROR for Organization).

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - display name for the agent.

sssom.object_label: CDIF Core Agent (prov:Agent / schema.org agent role pattern)
sssom.comment: DDI-CDI has no abstract 'Agent' class; Individual + Organization are siblings. Introduced here as an abstract parent so creator/publisher/contributor associations can target one end.

class._comment: schema:Person - human agent. DDI-CDI provenance anchor: Individual (the data-type/agent class for natural persons). Attribute set follows the CDIF Person building block (_sources/schemaorgProperties/person/schema.yaml): description, alternateName, affiliation (a schema:Organization), contactPoint (email only), sameAs. identifier and name are inherited from Agent. The full schema.org Person vocabulary (givenName/familyName/honorificPrefix/honorificSuffix/telephone/...) is intentionally NOT part of the restricted CDIF profile.
class.definition: schema:Person - a human agent (creator, contributor, publisher, etc.). Inherits identifier and name from Agent.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short textual description of the person.

attribute.name: alternateName
attribute.definition: schema:alternateName - other labels by which the person might be known.

attribute.name: affiliation
attribute.definition: schema:affiliation - organisational affiliation; per the CDIF profile the value must be a schema:Organization.

attribute.name: contactPoint
attribute.definition: schema:contactPoint - contact point for the person; the CDIF profile restricts this to email only.

attribute.name: sameAs
attribute.definition: schema:sameAs - other identifiers for the person, each a string or an @id object reference.

class._comment: schema:ContactPoint - restricted to email only per the CDIF Person building block (schema.org also allows telephone/postal). Used by Person.contactPoint. No DDI-CDI source class.
class.definition: schema:ContactPoint - a contact point for an agent. The CDIF profile restricts this to email only.

attribute.name: email
attribute.definition: schema:email - email address.

class._comment: schema:Organization - institutional agent. DDI-CDI has Organization as a class. Inherits identifier and name from Agent.
class.definition: schema:Organization - an organisational agent. Inherits identifier and name from Agent.

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.definition: schema:additionalType - a controlled-vocabulary subtype of the organisation (string or DefinedTerm).

attribute.name: alternateName
attribute.definition: schema:alternateName - acronym, abbreviation, or other alternative forms of the organisation's name.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short textual description of the organisation.

attribute.name: sameAs
attribute.definition: schema:sameAs - other identifiers for the organisation, each a string or an @id object reference.

class._comment: Contributor - the schema:Role/AgentInRole pattern. DDI-CDI's AgentInRole is a DataType (not a Class), so no sourceClass is set; the provenance link is recorded only in the SSSOM block.
class.definition: schema:Role / Contributor pattern. Pairs a Person or Organization (the contributor) with a roleName (e.g. principalInvestigator, curator, dataCollector).

attribute.name: roleName
attribute.definition: schema:roleName - the role played by this agent (DDI Lifecycle role term recommended).

sssom.predicate_label: Conceptually similar; DDI-CDI AgentInRole is a DataType so cannot be sourceClass.

class._comment: schema:DefinedTerm - controlled-vocabulary term used in keywords, additionalType, etc. Loose DDI-CDI anchor: Concept.
class.definition: schema:DefinedTerm - a term from a controlled vocabulary used as a value (keywords, additionalType, measurementTechnique, ...).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - URI for the term.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - the term's preferred label.

attribute.name: termCode
attribute.definition: schema:termCode - code value within the term set.

attribute.name: inDefinedTermSet
attribute.definition: schema:inDefinedTermSet - URI of the controlled vocabulary containing this term.

sssom.predicate_label: DefinedTerm is a flat schema.org notion; DDI-CDI Concept is richer (placed in a ConceptSystem).

class._comment: Identifier - schema:PropertyValue identifier (used for richly typed identifiers with propertyID/value/url). DDI-CDI's Identifier is a DataType (not a Class), so no sourceClass; SSSOM records the relation.
class.definition: schema:PropertyValue used as schema:identifier - a structured identifier with type, value, and URL.

attribute.name: propertyID
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - the identifier scheme (e.g. 'DOI', 'Handle', 'ROR').

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: schema:value - the identifier value.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - resolvable form of the identifier.

class._comment: AdditionalProperty (schema:PropertyValue in the key/value extension role). Distinct from Identifier (also schema:PropertyValue but in the identifier role). The string shorthand permitted for Identifier does NOT apply here - both the property name (propertyID) and the value are required to identify the assertion, so a bare string would be ambiguous. JSON instance MUST be an inline object or @id-reference.
class.definition: schema:PropertyValue in the AdditionalProperty role - a key/value extension property carrying a propertyID (property name) and a value, optionally with a unit. Used wherever schema:additionalProperty appears. See CDIFDiscoveryImplementationGuide.md (Polymorphism of PropertyValue) for the distinction from Identifier.

attribute.name: propertyID
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - identifier of the property being asserted (e.g. 'horsepower', 'serialNumber'). Either a literal string or a URI from a known vocabulary.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-readable label for the property (often equal to propertyID).

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: schema:value - the property value (literal).

attribute.name: unitText
attribute.definition: schema:unitText - unit of measure for the value (textual).

attribute.name: unitCode
attribute.definition: schema:unitCode - unit of measure for the value (URI from a known vocabulary, e.g. UCUM, QUDT).

sssom.object_label: CDIF Core AdditionalProperty (schema:PropertyValue in the AdditionalProperty role)
sssom.comment: Distinct from Identifier so the union-type policy does not collapse it to a string. See CDIFDiscoveryImplementationGuide.md Polymorphism of PropertyValue.

class._comment: Reference (the cdif:Reference type â€” local UML class matching the cdifProperties/cdifReference building block). Renamed from the previous 'LabeledLink' stub. Used wherever the JSON schema admits 'cdif:Reference | @id-ref | string' shape (license, conditionsOfAccess, publishingPrinciples, documentation, termsOfService, relatedLink, subjectOf).
class.definition: A typed reference to an external entity (cdif:Reference). Provides a labeled link surface (name, description, url) plus the DDI-CDI dt-Reference semantics (uri, optional cdif:semantic describing the role). See the cdifProperties/cdifReference building block for the full definition; this is the per-profile UML class that JSON-shape unions reduce to.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-readable label for the reference.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short summary of the referenced resource.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - presentation URL for the referenced resource.

attribute.name: relation
attribute.definition: dcterms:relation - canonical URI of the related resource (distinct from schema:url, the presentation URL).

attribute.name: hadRole
attribute.definition: dcat:hadRole - role of the related resource, as a controlled term (SKOS Concept / DefinedTerm).

class._comment: schema:MonetaryGrant - funding award. DDI-CDI's FundingInformation is a DataType (not a Class), so no sourceClass.
class.definition: schema:MonetaryGrant - a funding award supporting the creation of the resource.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - grant URI or award number.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - grant or programme name.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - description of the funding or grant.

class._comment: prov:Activity as used by CDIF Core via prov:wasGeneratedBy. Core uses the provProperties/generatedBy building block, which models the activity with ONLY prov:used (a brief reference to instruments/software/protocols). The richer PROV-O activity (provProperties/provActivity) and the schema.org-extended cdifProvActivity BB are used only by the cdifComplete / cdifXAS profiles, NOT by Core/Discovery/DataDescription/DataStructure. Do not add name/description/startedAtTime/etc. here.
class.definition: prov:Activity - the activity that generated this resource (object of prov:wasGeneratedBy). Per the provProperties/generatedBy building block used by Core, modelled with only prov:used.

attribute.name: used
attribute.definition: prov:used - an entity (instrument, software, or protocol, by URI) that this activity used.

class._comment: DerivedFrom - schema for prov:wasDerivedFrom sources. No DDI-CDI counterpart; plain new.
class.definition: prov:wasDerivedFrom payload - a cdif:Reference to an upstream resource the dataset was derived from (the JSON also admits a bare string or @id). Mirrors the cdifProperties/cdifReference building block.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-readable label for the source.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short summary of the source resource.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - presentation URL for the source resource.

attribute.name: relation
attribute.definition: dcterms:relation - canonical URI of the source resource.

attribute.name: hadRole
attribute.definition: dcat:hadRole - role of the source resource, as a controlled term (SKOS Concept / DefinedTerm).

class._comment: CdifCatalogRecord - the schema:subjectOf target carrying dcterms:conformsTo (which references the cdif/core/1.0 profile URI). Required on every CDIF resource. No DDI-CDI Class counterpart; CatalogDetails is a DataType, not a Class.
class.definition: schema:subjectOf target - the metadata-record-about-the-metadata. Carries dcterms:conformsTo (with @id constant https://w3id.org/cdif/core/1.0 in this profile), dateCreated, dateModified, identifier.

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.definition: schema:additionalType - additional type assertions for the catalog record node; dcat:CatalogRecord is required.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - profile identifier(s) this record conforms to. For CDIF Core: https://w3id.org/cdif/core/1.0 (required).

attribute.name: sdDatePublished
attribute.definition: schema:sdDatePublished - date the structured data (this metadata record) was published / last updated.

attribute.name: includedInDataCatalog
attribute.definition: schema:includedInDataCatalog - the source data catalog the metadata record originates from (a schema:DataCatalog reference).

association.definition: schema:provider - the agent providing access to the dataset. The Agent supertype admits Person or Organization.
schema:about - the resource this metadata record (CatalogRecord) describes.

association._comment: schema:distribution - single association on the AbstractDistribution supertype; replaces the previous Dataset_distribution_DataDownload + Dataset_distribution_WebAPI pair. Instance @type carries the concrete kind (schema:DataDownload or schema:WebAPI).
association.definition: schema:distribution - distributions of the dataset. The AbstractDistribution supertype admits schema:DataDownload (file-based) or schema:WebAPI (service endpoint).

association._comment: schema:creator - single association ending on the abstract Agent supertype. Replaces the previous pair of Dataset_creator_Person + Dataset_creator_Organization (which produced two visually overlapping associations in EA). The instance is either a Person or an Organization by virtue of Agent's generalization.
association.definition: schema:creator - the authors / originators of the dataset. The Agent supertype admits Person or Organization.
schema:contributor - other parties who played a role in production.

association._comment: schema:contributor - the Agent (Person or Organization) playing this role (the agentInRole BB names this slot 'contributor'). Single association on the Agent supertype; replaces the previous Contributor_agent_Person + Contributor_agent_Organization pair.
association.definition: schema:contributor - the Agent (Person or Organization) playing this contributor role.

association._comment: schema:publisher - single association on the Agent supertype; replaces the previous Dataset_publisher_Person + Dataset_publisher_Organization pair.
association.definition: schema:publisher - party who made the dataset publicly available. The Agent supertype admits Person or Organization.
schema:funding - funding awards supporting the resource.

association._comment: schema:funder - widened from Organization-only to Agent so a Person funder is also admissible (schema.org schema:funder accepts both).
association.definition: schema:funder - the funding party behind this grant. The Agent supertype admits Person or Organization.
prov:wasGeneratedBy - the activity that produced the resource.
prov:wasDerivedFrom - sources of data used in aggregate datasets.
schema:subjectOf - the metadata record describing this dataset (carries dcterms:conformsTo). Required.
schema:keywords - keywords expressed as controlled-vocabulary DefinedTerms (in addition to string-valued keywords on the Dataset itself).

association._comment: schema:provider on DataDownload (per the dataDownload BB). The Agent supertype admits Person or Organization.
association.definition: schema:provider - the agent that maintains this particular distribution option.

association._comment: schema:maintainer on CatalogRecord (per the cdifCatalogRecord BB). The Agent supertype admits Person or Organization.
association.definition: schema:maintainer - the agent that maintains the metadata record.
